name: Kittisak Chaiyong
bio:
Kittisak's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Logistics Management, focusing his studies on optimizing supply chains in high-pressure environments. After graduating, he interned with a smaller racing team, quickly proving his ability to handle complex logistical challenges under tight deadlines. His meticulous approach and proactive problem-solving skills caught the attention of McLaren Racing, where he now coordinates the movement of equipment and personnel across the globe.

Kittisak is known for his unwavering focus and dedication. He believes that a well-organized logistics operation is the backbone of any successful racing team. He strives to anticipate potential issues and implement preventative measures, ensuring that everything arrives on time and in perfect condition. While he values collaboration, he's also comfortable working independently and taking ownership of his responsibilities. His demanding nature pushes his team to perform at their best, but he always leads by example, putting in the extra hours to ensure success.

What sets Kittisak apart is his calm demeanor under immense pressure. He remains composed and analytical, even when faced with unexpected challenges. This ability to think clearly and make sound decisions in high-stakes situations makes him an invaluable asset to the McLaren Racing team. He is also a keen student of efficiency, constantly looking for ways to streamline processes and optimize performance.

physical.description: Kittisak is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.
